newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 47.647 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 47.647 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry on Thursday sold two discount T-bill issues with maturities of one week and four weeks, yielding 3.73 percent and 17.51 percent to maturity, respectively, the central bank said.
Bids were received for a total of 70.481 billion levs of T-bills but the ministry approved bids for 47.647 billion levs worth of paper.
The issues were offered with no par value or minimum acceptable price set in advance by the ministry. Auction date and maturity date for each issue overlap.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Bids received 57,639.6 million levs 12,840.9 million levs
Bids approved 39,505.9 million levs 8,140.9 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 3.73 pct 17.51 pct
